clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements for through hardened and tempered steel washers intended for assembly with large series hexagon, high strength structural bolts and nuts in the size range M16 to M36.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types Type A - Plain hole circular washers. Type B - Square taper washers for use with channels (60 taper) Type C-  Square taper washers for use with I-beams (80 taper)

clauses.title: Nominal Size (Thread Size
clauses.text: 3.1 Nominal Size (Thread Size of Associated Bolt) M16, M20, (M22), M24, (M27), M30 and M36. See Tables 1 and 2 of the standard.

clauses.title: The washers shall be
clauses.text: 3.2 The washers shall be flat with a maximum deviation not exceeding 0.25 mm from the straightedge laid along a line passing through the centre of the hole.

clauses.title: The hole of the
clauses.text: 3.3 The hole of the washer shall be concentric with the outside dimensions within 0.50 mm.

clauses.title: When circular or square
clauses.text: 3.4 When circular or square taper washers are required to be clipped to provide clearance, the clipped edge shall not be closer to the centre of the washer than 0.9 of the bolt diameter. In case of square taper washers, these may be clipped along the thin edge parallel to the opposite edge.

clauses.title: Material – The washers
clauses.text: 5. Material - The washers shall be made from 45C8 steel as perscribed.

clauses.title: Hardness – Shall be
clauses.text: 6. Hardness -  Shall be between 35 to 45 HRC. The minimum  for hot-dip galvanized washers shall be 26 HRC.

clauses.title: Finish – Shall be
clauses.text: 7. Finish -  Shall be supplied in the dull black heattreated condition with a residual coating of light oil.

clauses.title: Where washers are required to be hot
clauses.text: 7.1  Where washers are required to be hot-dip galvanized, they shall conform to the prescribed standard  except that the minimum value of average mass of coating shall be 300 g/m2.

clauses.title: General Requirements – In
clauses.text: 8. General Requirements - In regard to requirements not covered in the standard, the washers shall conform to the requirements specified for ordinary washers according to IS 5369 : 1975.

clauses.title: The high strength structural
clauses.text: 8.1 The high strength structural bolts to be used with these washers shall conform to the requirements of IS  3757:1985. #

clauses.title: The high strength structural
clauses.text: 8.2 The high strength structural nuts to be used with these washers shall conform to the requirements of IS  6623:1985. *

clauses.title: Designation – Shall be
clauses.text: 9. Designation - Shall be designated by the word `washer', nominal size, type and the number of this standard. In case of hot-dip galvanized washers the word galvanized' shall be added to the designation. Examples - A plain hole circular washer of nominal size M24 conforming to this standard and galvanized shall be designated as - Washer M24A -  IS 6649 galvanized.

clauses.title: A square taper washer
clauses.text: 9.1 A square taper washer of 60 taper for use with channels, of nominal size M24 conforming to this standard and galvanized shall be designated as - Washer M24B- IS  6649 galvanized. #  High strength structural bolts (second revision). * High strength structural nuts (first revision). + General reqirements for plain washers and lock washers (first revision) For detailed information, refer to IS 6649 : 1985  Specification for  hardened and tempered washers for high strength structural bolts and nuts (first revision). SUMMARY OF IS 6649 : 1985 HARDENED AND TEMPERED WASHERS FOR HIGH STRENGTH STRUCTURAL BOLTS AND NUTS (First Revision)
